behavior_constraints: Tool exists at /app/pipeline.sh and is a CLI supporting subcommands: validate, order, build, test, deploy, status, rollback, graph

validate parses /app/pipeline.yaml and checks YAML syntax, required service fields (path, build_cmd, test_cmd, port, depends_on, health_endpoint), required environment fields (deploy_target, health_check_port, max_replicas), no duplicate port assignments, no circular dependencies, all depends_on references point to defined services
validate prints VALID on success or ERROR: <description> with first error found
order prints topologically-sorted build/deploy order, one service per line, respecting depends_on, alphabetical sorting among services at same topological level
build without --service builds all services in dependency order
build with --service NAME builds only that service plus its transitive dependencies
build writes artifact at <service_path>/build/artifact.txt containing <service_name>:<epoch_seconds>:built
build prints BUILD <service_name> OK per service, or BUILD <service_name> FAIL: <reason> when service path doesn't exist
build with --parallel outputs parallelizable build waves, each line comma-separated services alphabetically sorted, services in same wave have no interdependencies within the building set
build with both --service and --parallel restricts waves to named service plus its transitive dependencies
entities.summary: Create a multi-service deployment pipeline orchestrator CLI at /app/pipeline.sh supporting validate, order, build, test, deploy, status, rollback, and graph commands with all persistent state under /app/.pipeline/.

The project already has a YAML manifest at `/app/pipeline.yaml` and a set of service directories under `/app/services/`. The manifest defines the services, their dependency relationships, and the target environments.

promote processes services in dependency order
promote prints `PROMOTE <service> -> <target>: SKIP (same version)` when target already has exact same version
promote prints `PROMOTE <service> -> <target> OK` when copying deployment to target
services not deployed in source are silently skipped during promote

instruction_head:
Extend the pipeline orchestrator with three new commands that build on the existing deployment infrastructure: `promote`, `diff`, and `history`. Additionally, all deployment-related commands must now record events into a per-environment event log so that history tracking works.

**`pipeline.sh promote <source-env> <target-env> [--service NAME] [--dry-run]`** — Copy deployment state from a source environment to a target environment. Both environments must exist in the manifest. Services are promo

behavior_constraints: Each service in the manifest must include a `version` field matching `N.N.N` (three dot-separated non-negative integers).
Manifest initial versions: api-gateway 2.1.0, user-service 1.3.0, order-service 1.0.0, notification-service 0.8.0, analytics-service 1.9.0.
validate must error when a service is missing `version` or its value does not match the N.N.N pattern.
build artifact format must be `<name>:<version>+build.<timestamp>` using the service's manifest version.

diff must extract semver (between first colon and `+build.`) and build timestamp (after `+build.`), compare major/minor/patch numerically (not lexicographically), use build timestamp as tiebreaker when semver identical.
diff output format remains: `DIFFERS: <service> <v1> vs <v2> (<envX> newer)`.
promote must detect downgrade conflicts: if target env has strictly higher semver than source, it is a conflict.
promote without `--force` on a conflict prints `CONFLICT: <service> -> <target>: downgrade (<source_semver> < <target_semver>)` and does not promote that service.
promote with `--force` overrides conflict, promotes the service, prints `PROMOTE <service> -> <target> OK (forced)`.
promote summary line must be `Promoted N, skipped M, conflicts C` where forced overrides count as promotions making C zero.
entities.summary: Migrate the pipeline orchestrator to semantic versioning by adding a `version` field to the manifest, modifying validate/build/diff/promote/history to use semver-aware logic, and adding a new `bump` command.
